Rail: Before you travel to the UK ​​You need permission to enter the UK. Check which visa you can apply for . Once your application has been processed, you’ll either get a visa or official letter of permission. You can use this to board a plane or other form of transport to the UK. Travelling with a permission to travel letter If you did not use the ‘UK Immigration: ID check’ app or attend a visa application centre, you may have been issued with a permission to travel letter to allow you to travel to the UK.

HS2: Major Road Network and Large Local Majors ( MRN / LLM ) programme funds large local highway authority transport schemes that could not be funded through the normal routes, such as the Local Transport Fund or other devolved allocations. The MRN is the middle tier of England’s busiest and most economically important local authority ‘A’ roads, sitting between the national Strategic Road Network ( SRN ) and the rest of the local road network.
Aviation: The Department for Transport is developing a strategy which will set the high-level direction for how transport should be designed, built and operated in England over the next 10 years. It will set out a single national vision which will put people who use transport and their needs at its heart and empower local leaders to deliver integrated transport solutions that meet the needs of their local communities.

Road Tax: The Electric Car Grant offers banded grant levels for vehicles priced at £37,000 or below. For a vehicle to be eligible for the grant, vehicle manufacturers need to provide: information about themselves and the vehicle evidence about the sustainability of vehicle manufacturing All evidence must be supplied in English. Vehicle manufacturers who want to apply for grant eligibility should complete this form and send it with the supporting evidence to ECGApplications@ozev.gov.uk .

Active Travel: Revision details Following the discovery of some duplicate figures in our raw data affecting the number of passengers that travelled on cruise and long sea journeys, revisions were made to the 2023 and 2021 figures in the latest sea passenger statistics. The revision made to the cruise and long sea passenger figures has had a minor effect on the total number of sea passengers for 2023 and 2021. This change has not affected the overall trends. Tables SPAS0101, SPAS0107 and SPAS0201 and the web release have been updated with the revised figures and charts.

Maritime & Ports: Accessibility of tables The department is currently working to make our tables accessible for our users. The data tables for these statistics are now accessible. We would welcome any feedback on the accessibility of our tables, please email maritime statistics . Tables FLE0202 and FLE0204 have not been updated in 2025 due to additional time needed to quality assure the direct owner variable following a methodological change by the data provider to how direct owner information is collected.

Drones: This good practice guide is aimed at highway authorities and organisations that need to carry out street works using licences issued under section 50 of the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991 ( NRSWA ). It provides advice on: when licences should be used good practice for dealing with applications the legislative background other issues, for example, asset ownership and maintenance, and fines and penalties The section 50 licence application template contains specimen wording that highway authorities can use in their application forms.
